name: ntr_db_get_monthly_period_ids
xsql:
SELECT child.period_id
FROM xactly.xc_period child
INNER JOIN xactly.xc_period parent 
    ON child.parent_period_id = parent.period_id
WHERE parent.period_id = :v_period_id
  AND LookupPeriodTypeById(child.period_type_id_fk) = 'MONTHLY'
ORDER BY child.period_id ASC
